fusions.name: Runaway Coach
fusions.desc: Sends a riderless coach thundering into the first enemy in its path. It deals 30 damage, and every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it takes 80% of that. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Hooves First
fusions.desc: You gallop up to 7 tiles to the target and strike as you arrive. It deals 14 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Full Gallop
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds, with +5% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Heart

riders.text: the road comes at you faster
your hands keep time with the hooves
and you are past before they swing

fusions.desc: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1.
